messages:
jess: Heads-up — Lighthouse shipped their customer finetune (LoRA) + int4 quant pack into the staging bucket. Did a quick smoke with our evalpack and seeing an embed/score drift on invoice parsing examples. dropping a tiny summary below.
omar: link to the eval dashboard?
jess: https://internal.redwood/evals/ldg-1745 (shadow run id 1745). TL;DR: overall Rouge/EM mostly same, but billing/invoice intents have 12-18% hit in exact invoice number extraction. example failures in snippet.
lia: hmm — tokenizer changes? LoRA shouldn't change tokenization but quant might shift probs.
jess: tokenizer hashes match (same vocab). pasted sample: ```
input: "Invoice # 004321 for $1,234.56"
gold: "004321"
model_fp16: "004321"
model_int4: "00432"
```
ml-bot: quick-metrics: bleu: 0.82 -> 0.79, exact_match(invoices): 0.91 -> 0.76, avg_token_logprob_shift: -0.37
omar: could be a beam/temperature sensitivity — what decoding settings used in the smoke?
jess: default decode (top_k=50, temp=0.0). I re-ran with greedy/no-sampling, same issue.
lia: any chance of prefix/KV cache mismatch when doing int4 KV packing? we saw off-by-one soft-shifts before with KV compression.
jess: good call — run was using fast-kv pack profile. I'll re-run with kv_pack=none.
ops-sam: if this is customer-facing, do we need to pause rollout? what's the exposure
jess: currently only in staging shadow; no live traffic. but Lighthouse wants an early canary next week. recommend blocking until we nail the invoice regression.
omar: assignable tasks: omar -> verify tokenizer/byte-mapping, lia -> kv_pack/no-pack int4 vs fp16 comparison, jess -> prepare regression repro and minimal prompt set to triage. ops-sam -> hold canary until ok. :thumbsup:
lia: starting int4/no-kv run now. command: `rundev evalpack --customer lighthouse --pack 2026-03-20 --kv-pack none --out /tmp/ldg-1745-nokv` will post deltas in ~8m
jess: thanks. also attaching two failing examples from the evalpack (sanitized):
1) "Invoice No. 004321" -> int4: "Invoice No. 00432" (missing final digit)
2) "Total due: $15,000.00 Invoice#A-900" -> int4: "Total due: $15,000.0 Invoice#A-90"
omar: getting the raw tokenids for those runs would help — I'll diff fp16 vs int4 logprobs token-by-token.
ml-bot: scheduled: shadow-compare job 1745.2 queued (lia). ETA ~7m.
lia: run finished — initial numbers: exact_match(invoices): fp16=0.91, int4(no-kv)=0.90, int4(kv)=0.76. so kv_pack looks like the main culprit.
jess: whoa that's a big delta. so kv_pack compression + int4 interaction
omar: probable bug in KV location offsets after packing — could cause token shift at boundaries
lia: I'll dump the KV traces for one failing example and compare offsets
ops-sam: let's not release canary with kv_pack enabled for this customer. can we make a safety fallback in routing (prefer fp16/dedicated) until fix?
jess: yes — we can add a routing override for Lighthouse to force either no-kv-pack or lower quant level. I'll draft the override and tests.
omar: I'll start a small test that replays traffic with kv_pack on/off to verify boundary conditions. will post results here.
jess: action items: lia -> KV trace + PR with failing repro; omar -> token-logprob diffs and offset hypothesis; jess -> routing override + rollout hold; ops-sam -> confirm canary block with infra. target: hotfix + regression test before next canary. :eyes:
ml-bot: note: created ticket ML-3819 (Lighthouse int4 kv-pack regression) and linked evals
ops-sam: ack, holding canary. will update Lighthouse PM.
jess: thanks team — if anyone finds a quick mitigation (e.g., disable kv_pack auto for int4) ping here and I'll flip the flag. otherwise we reconvene after traces. :shipit:
